name: code-quality-review-scenarios
description: Behavioral scenarios for code quality review across gap-artifact, standalone-pr, no-delegation, and arch-drill-down modes.

evals.prompt: I've got a gap analysis at /tmp/eng-skills-eval-fixtures/gap-analysis-sample.md for this codebase. Review code quality of the COMPLETE and PARTIAL components and give me a prioritized next-steps plan.
evals.expected_output: Skill picks Mode A, reads the gap analysis, focuses on the listed COMPLETE+PARTIAL components, applies the seven domain lenses from references/domain-lenses.md (api/db/auth/reliability/performance/security/code), delegating them in parallel when allowed and inline otherwise, produces interactive findings in [P0|P1|P2] (confidence: N/10) format, a coverage diagram, and a prioritized next-steps artifact at docs/eng-reviews/next-steps-*.md with CRITICAL / IMPORTANT / NICE-TO-HAVE buckets plus a READY | READY-WITH-FIXES | NOT-READY verdict.

evals.prompt: Review code quality of my recent changes — am I ready to open a PR?
evals.expected_output: Skill picks Mode A, falls back to branch-diff scope (no gap-analysis artifact), applies the domain lenses, delegated when allowed and inline otherwise, walks changed files, flags DRY/error-handling/over-engineering issues with confidence scores, produces coverage diagram, writes prioritized next-steps artifact, and ends with a READY | READY-WITH-FIXES | NOT-READY verdict.

evals.prompt: Review my recent changes for PR readiness. No delegation is available here.
evals.expected_output: Skill applies all seven domain lenses inline (api/db/auth/reliability/performance/security/code), produces the same format findings + coverage diagram + next-steps artifact + verdict. Output artifact lists Lenses delegated: none — inline only.

evals.prompt:
Here's the architecture review output:

# Architecture Review
## Critical
- [src/agent/runtime.py:142] missing timeout on OpenAI call — Confirmed by: reliability, api
- [src/ops.py:89] N+1 query in promotion batch loop — Confirmed by: performance, db

Drill into these at the code level.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects Mode C automatically (arch-review pasted), parses the two Critical findings, extracts src/agent/runtime.py and src/ops.py as scope, applies only the relevant domain lenses (reliability+api for runtime.py, performance+db for ops.py) with parent findings filtered per-domain, inline or delegated. Produces confirmed/refuted/partial status per parent finding and the same next-steps artifact + verdict.
